title: Reading an entry does not keep it from being evicted
issue: The cache is documented as least-recently-used, but only writes count as use. With capacity 2: put a, put b, get a, put c. The entry evicted is a, even though it was just read; b should be evicted instead.

steps.say: I'll start with the module the issue is about.
Before changing anything I want to see what the existing tests cover.
get returns the value without marking the entry as recently used; only put moves an entry to the end.
Running the tests again to confirm nothing that worked before is broken.

args.summary: get now moves the entry to the most-recently-used position before returning it.
